confidence_notes: FX is the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026, found via search. The food and drink anchors come from three searches of aggregator sites (Numbeo-style, crowdsourced), and those sources disagree widely, so I took mid-range values. Ocho Rios is a cruise-port tourist town and prices there run higher than the Jamaican average. I found no direct cocktail or wine prices. Cocktail and wine are set from beer at about 3x and 2.5x respectively, which is a rough basis. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge. I did not search for it. Hostels are scarce in Ocho Rios, so the hostel figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against Jamaican tourist hubs (Montego Bay, Negril) and Caribbean resort towns. Aggregator averages were adjusted upward for tourist-area pricing.
